title: The Little Brother (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 104bpm brushed drums walking bass character portrait family warmth Zimbabwe-Australia honest unhurried
lyrics:
[Intro - acoustic guitar, warm and unhurried]
There is a particular knowledge
That older brothers have
About younger brothers
That they will never say out loud

[Verse 1]
He was always the one who figured things out quietly
Didn't need to announce it when he'd worked something through
You'd just notice later
That Joel had already handled it
He was like that as a kid
And as it turns out
People don't really change
They just get better at what they already were

[Verse 2]
He went to a wedding or a party or somewhere
And Kerri was there
And he came home different
Not dramatically different
Not in a way you'd write a movie about
Just in the way a person comes home
When they've understood something
That they can now stop looking for

[Chorus]
The little brother
Who turned out to be the one who knew
The little brother
Who found Zimbabwe in Australia
Joel — who understood before he explained it
Joel — who came home different
The little brother
Did exactly right

[Bridge - spoken, warm and dry]
He brought her to meet the family.
Jeff and Jill flew over.
Everyone stood in a kitchen somewhere.
And it was immediately obvious
That this was just how it was now.
The good kind of obvious.
The kind where no one has to say anything
because the room has already decided.
The little brother.
Good one.

[Chorus reprise]
The little brother
Joel and Kerri
Red dust and southern rain
The little brother
Did exactly right

[Outro - guitar alone, smiling]
There is a particular knowledge
That older brothers have
About younger brothers
This is one of those times
When it's all good news
